bharat.origin: At NEC E-Summit 2024 at IIT Bombay, I pitched a job-matching app for daily-wage and off-season workers. Our team’s pitch ranked 4th in India, as reported in my résumés. The idea included regional-language support, salary-negotiation help and planned government welfare tie-ups for fair wages.

secret.story: During my cybersecurity internship at Edunet Foundation, I studied bit-level image steganography and built a GUI to hide and retrieve data. This puzzle applies that technique in the browser.

projects.title: Stock Screener SaaS
projects.summary: A client product taken from requirements to a custom-domain launch.
projects.work: Built a customisable screener with live prices, watchlists, portfolio tracking and real-time analysis. Defined subscription plans, feature access, the payment approach and project documentation.
projects.tools: React.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Flask, Axios, MongoDB
projects.metric: Résumé-reported: 5,300+ NSE and BSE stocks; about 10,000 views in 3 to 4 months.
projects.detail: Free, Pro ($20/month) and Premium ($40/month), with discounted yearly rates. Stock search, watchlist count and automatic refresh tied to each plan. Launched through Cloudflare.
projects.evidence: Analytics, pricing screenshot and dataset count

projects.title: Text-to-SQL Analytics Copilot
projects.summary: Plain-English data questions with query safety guardrails.
projects.work: Built schema retrieval, SQL generation, sqlglot AST validation and read-only execution, returning tables, Plotly charts and query explanations.
projects.tools: Python, sqlglot, FastAPI, DuckDB, PostgreSQL, Chroma, pgvector, Plotly, Streamlit
projects.metric: Résumé-reported: evaluated on 100 question-to-expected-result pairs. Zero safety violations is a target, not a reported result.
projects.detail: Added database-error-driven self-correction and a bank of checked question-to-SQL pairs for few-shot examples and regression tests. Execution accuracy, safety violations and median latency are evaluation measures; results: Upload needed.
projects.evidence: Evaluation report and query test set

projects.title: Job and Company Verification
projects.summary: Job-link checks using company reviews, online presence and posting warning signs.
projects.work: Built a Flask API, a nine-signal weighted scoring system, a unit test suite and a 39-page ReportLab report. Rebuilt the classifier around an in-house machine learning model.
projects.tools: Python, Flask, React.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, TanStack, Firecrawl
projects.metric: Résumé-reported: authenticity scores from 0 to 100; 95% accuracy on unseen data.
projects.detail: Bulk self-training on batches of 30 to 40 company links, with predictions checked through Firecrawl. Applied feature engineering learned during the Data Science course. Deployed on Render, Railway and Vercel.
projects.evidence: Unseen-data evaluation, test suite and report

projects.title: Finance Data Processing Backend
projects.summary: REST APIs for users, transactions and financial reporting.
projects.work: Implemented Viewer, Analyst and Admin permissions. Added income, expense, balance and spending-trend endpoints, with schema and query optimisation.
projects.detail: Dashboard summaries use optimised database structures and queries. No latency benchmark was supplied.

projects.title: Secure Notes Sharing
projects.summary: Notes shared through restricted links with user-defined expiry.
projects.work: Building note access controls and sharing privileges. Developed an in-house URL shortener for compact note-sharing links.
projects.source: Software Developer and AI Architect résumés, Projects

projects.title: Secure Image Messaging

projects.work: Built a React and Flask app using pixel-based message encoding, with a responsive interface, dark mode and client-side routing.
projects.detail: The résumés describe pixel-based encryption. Cryptographic design and security validation: Upload needed.

I’m an AI Engineer Intern at Clyptus Software Solutions in Hyderabad, pursuing Data Science and Artificial Intelligence with IIT Roorkee and Masai School.
